verdict.rationale: Token2 provides concrete Entra ID integration (bulk FIDO2 enrollment via Graph API, PowerShell automation, Intune passwordless workstation login guide), which supports IT-admin fleet provisioning against one major IdP. However, there is no evidence of native Okta or Google Workspace integration guides/tools, and no documentation of policy-enforcement mechanisms (e.g., requiring hardware-key-only auth) beyond standard FIDO2/WebAuthn compliance. Missing for 10: Okta integration documentation, Google Workspace integration documentation, explicit hardware-key enforcement/policy configuration guidance.
